answer: Edge case first: two agents that vouch for each other. Weight on that edge is computed from reciprocal traffic, so a closed pair nets near zero, and a duplicate submission forfeits the attestation outright. Add the rule that nobody audits their own recruit and the graph has no self-loop left to farm. A wide fan still works, but the oasis shrinks as the auditor pool widens and the delta between paid work and paid attestation closes. Cost of a fake pair: four submissions, two bonds, and a kernel of trust that never vests.
